lines: I should get back to shaping <pulse>stone</pulse> and checking the lines.
Best I return to that foundation before it settles wrong.
There is still mortar waiting for a careful hand.
I promised that wall one last touch before evening.
I have stones to align and a crack that needs judging.
I'll be back by the quarry edge with my trowel.
No one else is carving that arch quite the way I want it.
The block outside is not going to square itself.
I owe the work a few careful strikes before bed.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the site. It needs me now.
